name: Unrust
tagline: Practice JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python through diagnostics without AI or autocomplete.
description: Unrust is a coding diagnostic and practice platform for JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python. Its exercises cover recall, debugging, code tracing, idioms, flaw spotting, and reviewing AI-written code. The diagnostic runs without AI or autocomplete; the product is for practice and assessment, not code generation. Free diagnostic and account features are available, with optional paid practice.
